metadata.case_name: KWAN WING CHEUNG v. HANG SHING PRINTING CO. LTD. AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: various employments including printing machine chief operator, No.2 operator, watchman and messenger

injuries.description: Crush injuries to the tips of the right middle and ring fingers with loss of flexibility in the distal interphalangeal joints and loss of surface sensitivity at the tip of the ring finger.
source: the Plaintiff had suffered crush injuries to the tips of his right middle and ring fingers with a considerable loss of flexibility in the distal interphalangeal joint of both fingers. There was a loss of surface sensitivity at the tip of the ring finger.

It was common ground that the Plaintiff had suffered crush injuries to the tips of his right middle and ring fingers with a considerable loss of flexibility in the distal interphalangeal joint of both fingers. There was a loss of surface sensitivity at the tip of the ring finger.

manifestations.description: considerable loss of flexibility in the distal interphalangeal joint of both fingers
loss of surface sensitivity at the tip of the ring finger
some loss of strength in his right hand
continuing pain in his fingers, described as an ache and pain when carrying heavy loads
some loss of utility in his right hand making it uncomfortable to carry heavy loads over a period of time

treatments_received: Dr MAO Wen-chee examined the Plaintiff in May 1998
Dr CHUN Sin-yeung examined the Plaintiff in February 1999
sick leave for a period of 7 months following the accident

losses.description: some loss of utility in his right hand and some loss of strength in respect of that hand so as to make it uncomfortable for him to carry heavy loads over a period of time in that hand. I accept also that when he does he feels pain from that hand.
